CustomField.description: Total Paid Seats within the Organization / Number of Employees at the Company
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ISBLANK(paid_seats__c), ISBLANK(NumberOfEmployees), paid_seats__c = 0, NumberOfEmployees = 0 ), 0, paid_seats__c / NumberOfEmployees )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Total Paid Seats within the Organization / Number of Employees at the Company
CustomField.label: Company Penetration (Seats / Employees)
